column1: # Pre-resolved None-versus-zero mapping for the Python -> Go port.
# Analogue of Bun's LIFETIMES.tsv: the one ambiguity that recurs across every
# file, resolved once, centrally, so implementers grep this table instead of
# re-deriving it per site. Getting a row wrong is invisible at compile time and
# silently corrupts a column -- a Go zero value written where Python wrote SQL
# NULL is indistinguishable from a legitimate zero after the fact.
# USE THE go_type COLUMN VERBATIM. Do not infer it from the surrounding code.
# If a site you need is missing, stop and add it here first; do not guess
# can_be_none : can the Python expression evaluate to None?
# sql_null    : does None reach a SQL column as NULL? (n/a = not persisted)
# Line refs are against rig.py as of 2026-07-24 (672 lines).
